The legal battle over Tata Sons has brought the deepening rift within the Tata Group into focus. What is behind the dispute, what are the legal and corporate issues at stake, and what could happen next?
In this episode of Talking Politics, The Hindu’s Nistula Hebbar and senior journalist Prosenjit Datta unpack the Tata Sons courtroom battle, the power struggle behind it and its implications for the future of the Tata Group.
Thank you for watching our video!
